newsitem.title: USA: Scotland Bancorp sets special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Scotland Bancorp sets special dividend.

text.p: Scotland Bancorp Inc said its board declared a special one-time cash dividend of $6.00 per share, payable September 29, record September 15.

The company said it anticipates that the dividend will be considered a return of capital. As such, the dividend would be viewed as a reduction in the cost basis of each share of the company's common stock and would not be subject to income tax as a regular dividend to shareholders.

Because of the magnitude of the dividend declared today in relation to Scotland Bancorp's share price, the American Stock Exchange has determined that the company's shares of common stock will trade ex-dividend on September 30.
Shareholders are advised that if they sell their shares before the ex-dividend date, they will transfer the right to receive the special dividend to the buyers of the shares.
